card.name: Dosage-form word after drug or diluent
card.fires_on: Mainly the word Injection, tablets or capsules right after a drug or diluent name such as Sodium Chloride or Dextrose. Also fires on a few scattered words like 'number' after 'a' and on 'Reference' in review credits.

modes.label: Dosage form after name
modes.description: The product-form word follows a drug or diluent name in label text.
modes.example: or 0.9% Sodium Chloride<< Injection>> is required before administration to adult and pediatric

modes.label: Reference in review credits
modes.description: The word Reference in the Medical Review byline of a web health page.
modes.example: |Medical Review:||<<Reference>> Susan C. Kim, MD - Pediatrics

modes.label: Scattered general words
modes.description: Ordinary web words in the middle of a phrase, such as 'number' or 'to'.
modes.example: The universe is filled with a<< number>> of objects which are named as photons,
